While this Mini World Change is active, the snow on the glacier north of Svargrond starts to melt and reveals grass and rare plants. 15 {item:Ice Flower|Ice Flowers} appear which, when used, may give {item:Ice Flower Seeds}. Harvest 10 successfully to get the achievement Ice Harvester.
The snow on the glacier north of Svargrond suddenly starts to melt.
First Ice Flower, west of the path to Svargrond
Only while the Mini World Change is active.
Each Ice Flower only has a small chance (~20%) of giving seeds, so use every one you find.
After being harvested, an Ice Flower takes 4 hours to grow back: if other players passed by before you, you may find flowers that have already been harvested.
1. Check whether the glacier is melting

The event is active when messages such as *"Judging by the unnerved mammoths in Svargrond, enough snow has melted away to reveal some very special flora."* or *"Hear ye! Hear ye! Mammoths silently watch as the snow melts away. It reveals special flowers which are not meant to stay. Grow their seeds to brighten up your day!"* appear. At that point the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier|glacier} north of Svargrond starts to melt and {item:Grass (Tile)|grass} and other plants appear.

If you're not in **Svargrond**, take the boat in **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore** (tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city. Leave **Svargrond** to the north and climb the glacier (2 floors above ground level). The 15 {item:Ice Flower|Ice Flowers} are scattered around the area marked on the map.
On the way there are {creature:Winter Wolf|Winter Wolves}, {creature:Polar Bear|Polar Bears} and {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}.
Use each flower. There is about a 20% chance of receiving {item:Ice Flower Seeds}.

The flowers grow back 4 hours after the last harvest.

After 10 successful harvests you receive the **Ice Harvester** achievement.

To return, come down from the glacier the same way (2 floors down) to Svargrond; to leave the island, take {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat again.
